switches.summary: Light linear Hall-effect switch with a 30 gf starting force, 45 gf end force and 4.0 mm travel, designed for compatible Hall-sensor keyboards rather than standard mechanical PCBs.

sources.label: Wooting Lekker V2 L45 product page

compatibility: Requires a compatible Hall-effect keyboard; Wooting explicitly states it is not compatible with standard mechanical keyboards.

specification.note: Wooting publishes the 30–45 gf physical force range, 4.0 mm travel, contactless Hall-effect construction and lubrication. These values describe switch feel and travel, not electrical actuation latency.

switches.summary: Medium linear Hall-effect switch with a 40 gf starting force, 60 gf end force and 4.0 mm travel, positioned as the firmer Lekker V2 option for compatible Hall-sensor boards.

sources.label: Wooting Lekker V2 L60 product page

compatibility: Requires a compatible Hall-effect keyboard; Wooting explicitly states it is not compatible with standard mechanical keyboards.

specification.note: Wooting publishes the 40–60 gf physical force range, 4.0 mm travel, contactless Hall-effect construction and lubrication. The spring-weight difference should not be treated as a latency difference.

switches.summary: Light-version linear Jade Delta Hall-effect switch with a published 33 gf operating force, 3.5 mm travel and 150M-cycle rating.

sources.label: Gateron Magnetic Jade Delta product page

compatibility: Gateron specifies N-pole-down magnetic compatibility; verify keyboard polarity, flux curve, sensor calibration and firmware support before purchase.

specification.note: Gateron publishes 33±5 gf operating force for the Light version, 3.5±0.1 mm travel, 150M minimum cycles, factory lubrication and 120→700 GS magnetic flux at 1.2 mm PCB thickness. Atlas stores nominal values and keeps the published tolerances in this note.

switches.summary: Firmer Jade Delta Hall-effect variant with a published 38 gf operating force while retaining the 3.5 mm travel and 150M-cycle platform.

sources.label: Gateron Magnetic Jade Delta product page

compatibility: Gateron specifies N-pole-down magnetic compatibility; verify keyboard polarity, flux curve, sensor calibration and firmware support before purchase.

specification.note: Gateron publishes 38±5 gf operating force for the Dark version, 3.5±0.1 mm travel, 150M minimum cycles, factory lubrication and 120→700 GS magnetic flux at 1.2 mm PCB thickness. Atlas stores nominal values and keeps the published tolerances in this note.

switches.summary: Silent linear Hall-effect switch using mute pads and a dual-rail structure, with 35 gf initial force, 3.7 mm travel and a 100M-cycle rating.

sources.label: Gateron Magnetic Genty Silent product page

compatibility: Gateron specifies N-pole-down Hall-effect compatibility; verify the target keyboard's magnetic polarity and supported switch calibration before purchase.

specification.note: Gateron publishes 35±5 gf initial force, 3.7±0.2 mm travel, factory lubrication and 100M-cycle life. The silent construction is a physical/acoustic feature, not a claim of lower input latency.

switches.summary: Linear Hall-effect Jade variant with 36 gf initial force, 50 gf bottom-out force, 3.5 mm travel and a 150M-cycle rating.

compatibility: Hall-effect compatibility remains board-specific; verify magnet polarity, supported magnetic range and firmware calibration before purchase.

specification.note: Gateron publishes 36±5 gf initial force, 50±10 gf bottom-out force, 3.5±0.1 mm travel, 150M cycles, factory lubrication and 120→700 GS flux at 1.2 mm PCB thickness.

switches.summary: Linear Hall-effect Jade variant with a transparent housing, dual-rail-like stability treatment, 36 gf initial force and 3.5 mm total travel.

sources.label: Gateron Magnetic Jade / Pro / Max comparison
